data.name: NOL
data.detailed_description:
NOL is a first-person horror game with visuals inspired by noir horror manga. You play as Guntur, a young man who has his soul trapped in a cursed dream world after reading news about the massacre of his childhood friend's family. Since the game focuses on dreams, ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN.

Explore Guntur's friend's house in a noir cursed dream world and help him find clues to unveil what happened to his friend's family. However, this won't be easy, as Guntur faces many dangers and mysterious possibilities while you're only armed by households like sandals, dippers, water buckets, and any other households.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Explore a cool looking, dark, noir dream world inspired by black and white Japanese manga! All textures and sprites are manually hand drawn by human artist, Khalid Albakaziy

  • There are no firearms in this game, but instead household items such as sandals, buckets, dippers, and any other households to defend yourself from evil spirits

  • Unsettling SFX and BGM will accompany you in this game to make the gameplay more tense

  • The game focuses on a small house, but since you're in a dream world, anything can happen in this house AND to this house! Expect the unexpected!

  • This game runs on UZDoom, an idtech1 custom branch. This means the game will definitely runs on most of potato hardware (also the game only requires 100 MB hard drive free space!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows® 7, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 64-bit 2.0 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 5000 Series/NVidia GT 420
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 64-bit 2.0 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 5000 Series/NVidia GT 420/Intel HD 5000
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
